Verifies that CSP issue is created on the page for a module worker's import blocked by the page's policy.

Inspector issue: {
    issue : {
        code : ContentSecurityPolicyIssue
        details : {
            contentSecurityPolicyIssueDetails : {
                blockedURL : https://thirdparty.test/inspector-protocol/resources/to-be-blocked.js
                contentSecurityPolicyViolationType : kURLViolation
                isReportOnly : false
                violatedDirective : worker-src
            }
        }
    }
}
